column1: # Each row patches the pod `jail-cluster run --dry-run` renders (the base) with ONE yq expression
# and states the verdict the policy contract (ADR-167, the policy header's clauses a–n) demands:
#   pass = admitted · fail = refused BY the named clause · skip = not matched (outside jail-clusters)
# Every fail row breaks exactly one clause, and the clause letter is asserted from kyverno's message,
# so a row cannot pass by tripping a different rule. Run by scripts/jail-cluster-test.sh.
